# Additive Mahmud II lifespan. Do not edit other sp_* on_action files.
# Monthly so 1849.1.1 is not delayed until TUR's autumn yearly pulse.

on_monthly_pulse_country = {
	on_actions = {
		sp_mahmud_monthly
	}
}

sp_mahmud_monthly = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:TUR ?= this
				ruler ?= {
					has_template = tur_mahmut_osmanoglu_template
					has_trait = tuberculosis
				}
			}
			ruler = {
				remove_trait = tuberculosis
			}
		}
	}
	events = {
		sp_mahmud.1
	}
}
